title: The penalty that made me float

hook.spoken: Every legend has kicked me. Only one made me float.

shots.vo: Every legend has kicked me. Only one made me float.
shots.tts_text: Every legend has kicked me. Only one made me float.
shots.visual: Brand ball inside the gold rewind ring, pulsing

shots.vo: Belgrade. June 1976. The European Championship final went all the way to penalties.
shots.tts_text: Belgrade. June, nineteen seventy-six. The European Championship final went all the way to penalties.
shots.visual: Night stadium on cream paper, floodlights

shots.vo: West Germany against Czechoslovakia. Then Uli Hoeneß sent me sailing high over the bar.
shots.tts_text: West Germany against Czechoslovakia. Then Uli Hoeneß sent me sailing high over the bar.
shots.visual: Ball arcing over a crossbar, white kit silhouette

shots.vo: One more goal and Czechoslovakia were champions of Europe. Walking up to me... Antonín Panenka.
shots.tts_text: One more goal and Czechoslovakia were champions of Europe. Walking up to me... Antonín Panenka.
shots.visual: Player in red, number 7, walking to the spot

shots.vo: Sepp Maier dived. Panenka didn't blast me. He chipped me, softly, straight down the middle.
shots.tts_text: Sepp Maier dived. [pause:0.3] Panenka didn't blast me. He chipped me, softly, straight down the middle.
shots.visual: Keeper diving, ball floating the other way

shots.vo: I floated into the net like a feather. Czechoslovakia won the shootout, 5-3.
shots.tts_text: I floated into the net like a feather. Czechoslovakia won the shootout, five to three.
shots.visual: Ball settling in the net, gold light

shots.vo: Today, every chipped penalty in the world carries his name. They call it a Panenka.
shots.tts_text: Today, every chipped penalty in the world carries his name. They call it a Panenka.
shots.visual: Montage of chipped penalties in different kit colours

shots.vo: I was there. And honestly? I can still feel that chip.
shots.tts_text: I was there. And honestly? I can still feel that chip.
shots.visual: Brand ball inside the gold rewind ring
